method: Current regular-store menu, image filenames A3_Menu-normal_11nov. Calories are the official calculator at 25% sugar, regular ice, no toppings; whole-cup totals use official drink- and size-specific published values and round half up to whole kcal exactly as the public calculator. Per100ml = round(official medium cup kcal ×100 / official medium drink volume), matching the public calculator. Preserve each size recipe; do not assume standard 480ml/700ml. Nutri-Grade is transcribed from the current menu for iced100% sugar. Almond option prices add the menu-stated $0.30; grades use calculator100% for almond recipes. Hot option existence is noted on applicable drinks, without inventing separate hot nutrition/volumes or standalone prices. No Healthier Choice certification inferred.
scope: Import every unique drink priced in the current regular-store menu, plus its seven explicitly priced almond substitutions. Exclude calculator-only seasonal/protein/LongJing drinks absent from the current menu, standalone toppings and Playground food. Duplicate menu listings are not duplicate records.
statisticsValidation: ARS validate, ANALYZED: deterministic conversions and display rounding from published source inputs, not a sampling study. No confidence intervals or significance tests apply. All11 statistical fallacy classes reviewed; no subgroup trend, individual inference, selected-sample correlation, adjusted model, diagnostic rate, pre/post effect, survival inference, significance selection/model search, causal or reverse-causal claim. Serving and preparation applicability retained per record; source data may change.
